Really? a devotional behind a paywall?. As a believer, I truly don’t understand why access to encouragement, prayer, and the Word needs to come with a subscription. Jesus never charged people to hear the gospel. In fact, Scripture says, “Freely you have received, freely give.” (Matthew 10:8)

I know people put time and effort into devotional writing and app development, and I respect that. It’s especially disheartening for those who may be struggling and can’t afford to pay, yet are seeking God.

Please consider making the full devotionals free and trusting that God will provide another way to sustain this ministry. The gospel was meant to be shared, not sold.
